title: Run wolfcrypt test suite under ASAN with crypto2dev sim enabled
description: Build wolfSSL with ASAN and crypto2dev simulator, run the full test suite. This catches double-free, use-after-free, and heap-corruption bugs that code review may miss. Relevant bugs: qsi.2 (HMAC COPY aliased devCtx → double-free if wc_HmacCopy is reachable), qsi.3 (ECC COPY aliased fd → double-close). Build command: ./configure --enable-cryptocb --enable-cryptocbutils=free,setkey --enable-crypto2dev --enable-crypto2devsim CFLAGS='-g -O1 -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer' && make -j$(nproc) && ./wolfcrypt/test/testwolfcrypt. A clean ASAN run does not rule out qsi.2/qsi.3 (COPY paths may not be exercised by the test suite), but a dirty run confirms a live path.
